protocol.clock: serial: common fixed preparation + freshly measured CPU stages + recorded BW1000 profiling wall costs
protocol.initial_fee: per repeat, charge identical initial fit/rank time from initial-only to every policy; retain raw stage timings; only initialization is aligned
protocol.decision: retain public singleton all-device-zero plan until initial fit/rank; retain previous decision during acquisition, profiling and refit
protocol.primary: forced pool replay, decisions evaluated at common fixed time budgets
protocol.secondary: prefix replay at first nonpositive score; Random runs to exhaustion; no future outcomes affect cutoff
protocol.controls: initial-only fits/ranks once; reference-only holds public all-device-zero plan at zero incremental cost
protocol.model: same nearest-shape mean, distance-floor uncertainty, analytic x360 denominator, five samples
protocol.order: rotate strategy/seed order by task; reverse in alternate repeat; no audit in timing
protocol.aggregation: average seeds/repeats within task, then configurations equally
protocol.scope: development fixed Oracle-containing pools; existing training labels are sunk; not measured end-to-end wall time or independent blind tasks
